Scope: PR objectui#10954, card objectui#10913. One commit on `claude/issue-10913-read-rate-banner-export-claim-2`, parent `5c94589f0` (the PR base). `git diff --numstat` against the merge base: `2 1 .changeset/9954-read-rate-banner.md`, one file. Read 2026-09-28T10:57Z at objectui `origin/main` `06a96e948`, which changed none of the files named below since the base. Successor of PR objectui#10949 (`1df262efb`, closed unmerged 2026-09-28T10:51:09Z): `git patch-id --stable` gives `2e6c60c1c9aaff0ada2c91c0b464c8fb68e78718` for both commits and the changeset blob is `e53cf5683` on both heads. Dev report `5868163799` was read as a claim; every measurement below is this reviewer's own.

### ① Derived judgments

The new sentence, "Neither is exported from the package entry; a host reaches the banner only through `ConsoleShell`, which mounts it.", is TRUE of `main`:

- `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` at `origin/main`: `grep -c ReadRate` = 0, control `grep -c ConsoleShell` = 2. The file has no `export *`. Its two re-export lists from `./hooks/index.js` and `./layout/index.js` are named lists, and neither names `useReadRateReading`, `ReadRateBanner`, `classifyReadRate` or any read-rate type. The two sub-barrels do list the pair; nothing exports the barrels themselves. `index.ts` is identical at the head and at `origin/main`.
- `packages/app-shell/package.json` `exports` maps only `.` and `./styles.css`, so no subpath reaches `src/hooks` or `src/layout`. No file under `apps/` or `examples/` deep-imports `@object-ui/app-shell/src` or `/dist`.
- `ConsoleShell` IS exported from the entry, in the `./console/ConsoleShell.js` block. It renders the module-private `ConsoleShellProviders`, which mounts `ReadRateBanner` beside `ImpersonationBanner` and `StorageUsageBanner`. `ConnectedShell`, the other shell exported from that module, mounts only the data layer.
- "only through `ConsoleShell`" does not overclaim. Outside tests, `ConsoleShell.tsx` is the only importer of `ReadRateBanner` in the repository (the layout barrel re-exports it, and nothing outside the package can address the barrel). `ConsoleLayout` and `ConsoleNotificationBanners`, both exported, do not mount it, and the banner's own docblock records why both were rejected. The hook is reachable from no export at all, which "Neither is exported" covers.
- The rest of the changeset still holds at `origin/main`: `useAiUsage` sits in the same hooks barrel; the three pinned properties map to `useReadRateReading.test.tsx` (an absent `readRate` reported as `unmeasured`, an absent `readsPerWrite` classified as the no-writes case, `state` read and never re-derived) and to `ReadRateBanner.test.tsx` (the no-writes wording, the threshold taken from the wire, admin-only with no request from an ordinary session); the banner gates the request on `useWorkspaceAdminStatus`; each of the ten locale packs carries exactly four `console.readRate.*` keys. The edited paragraph reads coherently: line 16 still says "mounted in `ConsoleShell`", and the new sentence adds the non-export fact and the host's one route to the banner.
- Frontmatter: byte-identical to `origin/main`'s. Lines 1 to 4 `diff` empty, md5 `968447afe5dcc68a61ebd72735515e1f` on both sides.
- Commit message at the head (`git log -1 --format=%B`): no model name. The trailer pair is `Co-Authored-By: Claude` plus `Claude-Session:`. Observation, not a defect: the last 30 agent commits on `main` spell the key `Co-authored-by`; git and GitHub read trailer keys case-insensitively, and no objectui gate reads the commit message.

### ② Semver level

Declared bumps unchanged: `'@object-ui/app-shell': minor` and `'@object-ui/i18n': minor`, the same bytes as `origin/main`. No new changeset is owed: the diff touches `.changeset/` only, and no released package source or published contract changed. Head check-runs on `d28ba66c9`, read over REST: 41 runs, 38 success, 3 skipped (`Test (coverage)`, the coverage shard matrix placeholder, `dependabot`). Every changeset gate is success: Changeset Declaration, Changeset Claim Re-read, Changeset Overwrite Report, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Fixed Group Check. Control Byte Scan, Line Citation Gate, Lint, Type Check, Test shards 1 to 8, Test (dist pins), Build and E2E, Spec Main Shape Gate: all success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- In-place edit versus dated note: the sentence WAS born false. The changeset's only commit on `main` is its adding commit `c698a814a` (PR objectui#10052, 2026-09-20). `index.ts` at that commit: 0 `ReadRate` hits, control 2, no `export *`. `git log -S ReadRate` on `index.ts` over the whole history returns nothing (control `-S ConsoleShell` returns one commit). The in-place edit that triage `5865850392` note 1 directs is the right repair; the two dated-note precedents repaired sentences a later PR had rotted, which is not this case.
- PR body: no angle brackets, no `path:NN` line addresses, no model name. Every checkable claim re-measured true: numstat 2/1, frontmatter md5 `968447af`, patch-id `2e6c60c1`, sole importer, `ConsoleShell` exported, base `3b469c8ea` equal to `5c94589f0` on every named file, and `check-changeset-overwrite`'s own case 2 ("prose that no longer matches the change") is the report-only reading it gives. The gate table is stamped at `1df262efb` and says so; the check-runs above are the evidence for this head.
- Release PR objectui#5400 is OPEN (`changeset-release/main`, last updated 2026-09-18). `.changeset/9954-read-rate-banner.md` is still on `origin/main` `06a96e948`, its blob unchanged from the PR base. Not moot.
- PR objectui#10949 is closed unmerged with a comment naming this successor. Its commit `1df262efb` carries the model-named trailer, and nothing from it lands.

Defects found: none.
